title: The Pit Brawl
text: A ring of demons squats around a fighting pit, roaring, stamping, gnawing on bones. The sand below is black with old blood. If one of the living fights as their champion, they will let the rest pass. Their eyes go to whoever has killed the most.

options.label: The one with the most kills goes down into the pit, so the rest may pass.

outcomes.text: They win. The demons cheer like a crowd at a fair.
They lose and live, which the demons find very funny.

options.label: The craftiest fixes the fight; demons are not the only ones who can cheat.

outcomes.text: The demons never notice. Some of the bets were very large.

options.label: Everyone goes down into the pit together; let them choke on the whole party.

outcomes.text: The demons love it. They send down something worthy of the crowd.
